text: At all hours, paramedics and ambulances must frequently attend 750 Dundas Street West, a medical facility managed by the University Hospital Network. It is located across the street from the Toronto Western Hospital. The curbside in front of the building is currently signed No Parking/afternoon rush-hour No Stopping, and there is no curb cut. Paramedics have urgently requested that the bylaw regulations at this location be amended to ensure that ambulances have room to stop there whenever actively picking up or dropping off patients. That is, the curb must remain clear of parked or stopped vehicles at all times. They have also requested a curb cut, so they are not forced to lift loaded stretchers over the curb.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the existing parking machine regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m. Saturday and from 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Sunday, at a rate of $4.50 per hour and for a maximum period of three hours, on the north side of Dundas Street West, between a point 29.2 metres east of the east curb line of Palmerston Avenue and Bathurst Street, to be in effect from a point 29.2 metres east of the east curb line of Palmerston Avenue and a point 31 metres west of Bathurst Street. 2.
